_comment: This is NOT deployed from here — it's documentation only.
This app shares its Firebase project (truck-talk-admin) with truck-talk-webapp on
purpose, for one continuous sign-in/progress history. Firebase Realtime Database rules
are a single full-replace document for the whole project, not per-repo, so this exact
block is already live (deployed from truck-talk-webapp on 2026-11-03, commit 7bfd5ee,
before the app moved to its own repo). It is the ONLY piece of this app that still
lives in Firebase rather than here.
DO NOT run `firebase deploy --only database` from this repo — it has no idea about
truck-talk-webapp's other rules (users/, progress/, speakup/, liveClasses/, etc.) and
would silently wipe all of them, since a rules deploy replaces the entire ruleset.
If truck-talk-webapp's own rules are ever redeployed from that repo, this exact block
needs to be pasted back into its database.rules.json first, or writes here will start
failing with a permission-denied error (reads/writes to arabic/progress/$uid).
